method.percentile: CFTC legacy futures-only, trailing 156 reports, mid-rank, point in time (house method)
method.entry: close on the Friday after the Tuesday observation; forward 4, 8 and 13 week simple returns
method.crowded_long: managers >= 90th percentile and commercials <= 10th on the observation
method.relative: within a complex, weeks where A's managers percentile exceeded B's by 50 points or more; the statistic is B's forward return minus A's, against the pair's unconditional spread
method.caveats: forward windows overlap so n counts weeks, not episodes (n_thin keeps every 8th week); no costs; indices carry a long drift; Russell data from 2017; history, not probability
